_comment: Items (fish are defined in fish.json). category: resource | supply | curio | quest | junk | gift. value = base coin value. stack = max per slot.

wild_mint.name: Wild Mint
wild_mint.desc: Fresh and bright. Brews a calming tea.

blossom_sprig.name: Blossom Sprig
blossom_sprig.desc: Pink petals that never quite stop falling.

reeds_bundle.name: Reed Bundle
reeds_bundle.desc: Useful for baskets, roofs and whistles.

driftwood.name: Driftwood
driftwood.desc: Silver-grey wood polished by the river. Shipwrights love it.

orchid.name: River Orchid
orchid.desc: A delicate bloom that grows in the spray of waterfalls.

vanilla_pod.name: Vanilla Pod
vanilla_pod.desc: Sweet-scented and prized in cold towns.

river_clay.name: River Clay
river_clay.desc: Smooth grey clay for pots and plaster.

chestnuts.name: Chestnuts
chestnuts.desc: Roast them over a fire on a cold evening.

amber_resin.name: Amber Resin
amber_resin.desc: Golden sap, sometimes with a tiny insect caught inside.

mountain_herb.name: Mountain Herb
mountain_herb.desc: A bitter herb that grows above the cloud line.

slate_flake.name: Slate Flake
slate_flake.desc: Thin grey stone that splits into perfect tiles.

clear_quartz.name: Clear Quartz
clear_quartz.desc: Holds the light of the Crystal Lakes.

blue_lichen.name: Blue Lichen
blue_lichen.desc: Used for a lovely pale-blue dye.

ochre_pigment.name: Ochre Pigment
ochre_pigment.desc: Red earth ground to powder. The old painters used it.

desert_sage.name: Desert Sage
desert_sage.desc: Silvery leaves that smell of warm stone.

bamboo_shoot.name: Bamboo Shoot
bamboo_shoot.desc: Tender and crisp after the rains.

lotus_seed.name: Lotus Seed
lotus_seed.desc: Said to bring luck to those who carry one.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.desc: A mushroom that glows softly teal after dark.

ember_moss.name: Ember Moss
ember_moss.desc: Warm to the touch, even on frosty mornings.

cloudberries.name: Cloudberries
cloudberries.desc: Amber berries of the northern bogs.

pine_resin.name: Pine Resin
pine_resin.desc: Sticky and fragrant. Seals boats and lanterns.

seashell.name: Spiral Shell
seashell.desc: Hold it to your ear and hear the sea.

sea_glass.name: Sea Glass
sea_glass.desc: Old bottles, softened by a hundred years of waves.

frost_lichen.name: Frost Lichen
frost_lichen.desc: Crisp white lichen from the high snows.

ice_crystal.name: Ice Crystal
ice_crystal.desc: It never seems to melt. Nobody knows why.

lumen_bloom.name: Lumen Bloom
lumen_bloom.desc: A flower that glows like starlight. Only grows by the Starwater.

star_shard.name: Star Shard
star_shard.desc: A sliver of pale stone with light trapped inside.

bait_worms.name: Bait Worms
bait_worms.desc: Fish bite a little faster. Used one per cast.

glow_bait.name: Glow Bait
glow_bait.desc: Attracts night fish and rarer species. Used one per cast.

river_tea.name: River Tea
river_tea.desc: A warm cup. Drink it to rest and let an hour drift by.

honey_cake.name: Honey Cake
honey_cake.desc: Everybody likes honey cake. A lovely gift.

paint_teal.name: Teal Paint
paint_teal.desc: Paint your boat the colour of deep river water.

paint_rose.name: Rose Paint
paint_rose.desc: A warm rose, like blossom at dusk.

paint_moss.name: Moss Paint
paint_moss.desc: Mossy green for a boat that wants to hide in the reeds.

old_coin.name: Old River Coin
old_coin.desc: Stamped with a lantern and seven stars.

carved_token.name: Carved Token
carved_token.desc: A little wooden boat, worn smooth by many hands.

pressed_flower.name: Pressed Flower
pressed_flower.desc: Kept between the pages of someone's diary.

old_boot.name: Old Boot
old_boot.desc: Somebody lost more than a fish.

lamplighter_medallion.name: Lamplighter Medallion
lamplighter_medallion.desc: Oona's medallion. Seven small stars, three of them polished bright.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.desc: Wrapped in waxed cloth and tied with twine.

lost_compass.name: Brass Compass
lost_compass.desc: Its needle trembles, then points downstream.

lost_locket.name: Silver Locket
lost_locket.desc: A tiny painting of two people on a boat.

lost_flute.name: Reed Flute
lost_flute.desc: Someone's favourite tune is still in it.

lost_map.name: Faded Map
lost_map.desc: A hand-drawn map with a cross on it.
